tools.name: search_vessels
tools.description: Find vessels by name, MMSI or IMO number (a prefix of at least 2 characters works), among the vessels our sources have heard. Each comes with her particulars and her last position from a source we may pass on. Use it to turn a name into an MMSI for the other tools. Credits: 1 per vessel returned. Fr

tools.name: get_vessel
tools.description: One vessel now: her last position, speed, course, heading and navigational status from a source we may pass on, with her particulars (name, IMO, call sign, type, size, flag) and voyage (destination, ETA, draught). Give her MMSI, or her IMO number (then she is found by search first, 1 credit more). C

tools.name: vessels_in_area
tools.description: Vessels inside a latitude/longitude box, newest report first, each at her last position from a source we may pass on. truncated says that more were left out. Largest box: 1 square degree on a free account, 4 on Plus, 25 on Pro, 100 on Scale. Credits: 1 per vessel returned. Free accounts too: their a

tools.name: vessels_near
tools.description: Vessels within a radius of a position or of another vessel, nearest first, each with her distance in nautical miles and true bearing from the centre. It asks for the square around the circle, which must fit your plan's largest box (1 square degree on a free account, 4 on Plus, 25 on Pro, 100 on Scal

tools.name: vessel_track
tools.description: One vessel's recorded positions, oldest first, from the sources we may pass on: give hours back from now (default 72) or a from/to window. Long tracks are thinned evenly to max_points for reading; the credits count the whole range. Reach back: 90 days on Plus, 365 on Pro and Scale. Credits: 1 per ve

tools.name: vessel_port_calls
tools.description: Where a vessel called, from when to when, the gaps when no receiver heard her and the events along the way, for the last days asked (default 7), from all the AIS we hear (the ports and times; a position only where we may pass it on). Reach back: 90 days on Plus, 365 on Pro and Scale. Credits: 1 per

tools.name: vessel_activity
tools.description: A summary of how a vessel spent the last days (default 30): hours under way, in port, stopped off a port, stopped elsewhere and not heard, the distance sailed, her speeds, her calls and the ports she called at most. Reach back: 90 days on Plus, 365 on Pro and Scale. Credits: 5. Needs a paid plan: Da

tools.name: sanctions_check
tools.description: Whether a vessel's IMO number is on the public sanctions lists we read (the US OFAC SDN list, the UK Sanctions List, the EU vessel lists and Australia's sanctioned vessels), with what each list says of her. Matched by IMO number only: information, not a compliance determination. Credits: 1. Needs a

tools.name: search_ports
tools.description: Ports by name, UN/LOCODE or English name, ranked for a seafarer; or the ports nearest a position. Free. Free accounts too: their answers are 24 hours behind, with a box of at most 1 square degree and 1,000 credits a month; paid plans are live.

tools.name: resolve_destination
tools.description: The port an AIS destination text names (such as "NL RTM" or "ROTTERDAM PILOT"), or null. Free. Free accounts too: their answers are 24 hours behind, with a box of at most 1 square degree and 1,000 credits a month; paid plans are live.

tools.name: port_now
tools.description: A port's picture now: vessels in port and at anchor, vessels expected (arriving) and the latest port events. Give a UN/LOCODE or a name. Credits: 5, nothing when the port is empty. Free accounts too: their answers are 24 hours behind, with a box of at most 1 square degree and 1,000 credits a month;

tools.name: port_vessels
tools.description: A port's list of vessels: expected (bound for it), in port now, arrived or departed over the last 7 days. Filter by kind, flag and length. Credits: 1 per vessel returned. Needs a paid plan: Data API Plus, Pro or Scale, or a paid Watch plan (https://gangwayais.com/#pricing).

tools.name: port_waiting_times
tools.description: Waiting times at anchor off a port: the median this week against what is normal there, and optionally the vessels waiting now. Credits: 5, nothing when we hold no figures for it. Needs a paid plan: Data API Plus, Pro or Scale, or a paid Watch plan (https://gangwayais.com/#pricing).

tools.name: port_calls_on_date
tools.description: The seagoing vessels alongside in a port on one UTC day (default today), with when each made fast and left. Reach back: 90 days on Plus, 365 on Pro and Scale. Credits: 1 per call. Needs a paid plan: Data API Plus, Pro or Scale, or a paid Watch plan (https://gangwayais.com/#pricing).

tools.name: port_congestion
tools.description: How busy a port is against its own normal: an index, vessels waiting now, the median wait and the arrivals and departures day by day over the last days (default 30). Credits: 5, nothing when we hold no figures for it. Needs a paid plan: Data API Plus, Pro or Scale, or a paid Watch plan (https://gang

tools.name: port_events
tools.description: Recent events from AIS: arrivals, departures, anchoring, weighing anchor and approaches by default; also pilot, tug, bunkering, waiting, renamed and more. Optionally inside a box (at most 400 square degrees). Since defaults to the last 24 hours, at most 30 days back. Credits: 1 per event. Needs a pa

tools.name: plan_route
tools.description: A sea route between two positions, through the traffic separation schemes, with its distance and legs. Give the vessel's length and draught to keep her in water deep enough. A planning aid from charts and data that can be wrong: never for navigation. At most 6 a minute. Credits: 10. Needs a paid pla

tools.name: check_route
tools.description: Check a planned route leg by leg against land, depth (her draught plus the under-keel clearance), sea room and the traffic separation schemes, with plain-language warnings for what it finds. A planning aid: it finds what our charts and data show, never everything; not for navigation. At most 30 a mi

tools.name: depth_at
tools.description: The charted water depth at a position from EMODnet Bathymetry (European waters), or none where it has no figure. Not for navigation. Credits: 1, nothing where there is no depth. Needs a paid plan: Data API Plus, Pro or Scale, or a paid Watch plan (https://gangwayais.com/#pricing).

tools.name: account_usage
tools.description: Your key's plan, the credits used and left this month, when they renew, and the plan's rate, largest box, reach back and delay. Free. Free accounts too: their answers are 24 hours behind, with a box of at most 1 square degree and 1,000 credits a month; paid plans are live.

tools.name: data_sources
tools.description: The sources behind the answers, each with its licence, the credit to show and what it covers, and how far back our recorded history goes. Free. Free accounts too: their answers are 24 hours behind, with a box of at most 1 square degree and 1,000 credits a month; paid plans are live.
